name: cable horizontal pallof press v. 2
description: An anti-rotation press where you push a cable straight out and resist the twist. Great for core stability.
instructions: Stand sideways to a cable set at chest height, hands holding the handle at your chest.
Step away to load the cable and brace your core.
Press the handle straight out in front of you.
Hold for a second without rotating.
Bring it back to your chest, then switch sides.
